events.title: Updated demo + talent tree!
events.summary: Talents are in the demo! 🌳 Hi everyone! In my last post I said the demo would stay as is and talents would wait for the big update. But balance testing showed that doesn't work, so I changed my approach. So the demo is updated and talents are already there. Come try them! What else changed:Talents are simpler: one pick, and you get the bonus right away.Tooltips should be clearer.The start of the game is gentler.Thanks for playing, and stay tuned 💪

events.summary: 🆕 New feature: ContractsAdded a new system to the game — Contracts. events.title: Demo is Live – Try for Free Now!
events.summary: The free demo is live.I've been building this solo for a while, and today is the first time anyone can actually play it. Honestly a bit terrifying.Every click on your PC fires a shot at enemies running across your screen. Kill them, collect loot, upgrade your gear – and keep doing whatever you were doing on your computer.Would love to hear what you think. Enjoy!
